title: Metal Organic Framework-Derived Metal Phosphates as Electrode Materials for Supercapacitors

nodes.label: Converting a Ni-MOF into a MOF-derived nickel phosphate should give a better supercapacitor electrode than the MOF

requires_unseen: paper title: MOF-derived metal phosphates as electrode materials for supercapacitors

nodes.label: Ni-MOF built from Ni octahedra linked by benzene-tricarboxylate ligands is the precursor and template

attrs.image_note: Scheme draws Ni(O)6 centres bridged by 1,3,5-benzenetricarboxylate linkers with H-bonds; the ligand identity is read from the drawn structure

nodes.label: Convert the MOF by hydrothermal reaction with sodium phosphate so phosphate replaces the carboxylate linkers

attrs.image_note: Arrow in Scheme 1 is annotated 'Sodium phosphate / Hydrothermal Synthesis'; product drawn as Ni-O-P network with P=O and P-OH groups

nodes.label: Hydrothermal phosphatisation of Ni-MOF with sodium phosphate yields NixPyOz

requires_unseen: Scheme 1 caption: synthesis of NixPyOz from Ni-MOF

nodes.label: Carboxylate linkers are removed and P-O phosphate groups now coordinate Ni in the product
The product is a poorly crystalline nickel phosphate indexed to JCPDS 04-010-2575

attrs.image_note: only three broad humps (~20.5, ~30, ~35 deg 2theta) sit near the -112, -222 and 400 card lines; the strongest low-angle card line (~14.6 deg) has no counterpart

nodes.label: The MOF rod shape is retained as a template while rod surfaces become rough and nanoparticulate

requires_unseen: which SEM panel is Ni-MOF and which is NixPyOz (caption only)

nodes.label: The phosphate electrode stores far more charge per mass than the MOF (larger CV currents, longer discharge)

requires_unseen: sample identity of CV panels a/b and GCD panels c/d (caption only)

nodes.label: The phosphate electrode has lower series resistance and no resolved high-frequency charge-transfer arc
Rate capability improves: 64% of the 1 A/g capacitance kept at 20 A/g vs 19% for the MOF
Specific capacitance about 1620 F/g at 1 A/g for NixPyOz vs about 400 F/g for Ni-MOF
Over 10000 cycles capacitance falls from ~1100 to ~590 F/g with ~100% coulombic efficiency

nodes.label: Phosphate-coordinated Ni sites on a nanoparticulate surface give accessible faradaic Ni redox storage with fast charge transfer
Hydrothermal phosphatisation turns Ni-MOF into a nanostructured nickel phosphate with ~4x the capacitance and better rate capability
The phosphate is thermally stable to 600 C while the MOF framework decomposes near 420-520 C
MOF carboxylate bands at 1624, 1565, 1436 and 1338 cm-1 are absent in the derived material

notes: Captions only. Packet F-ids are offset by one from paper figure numbers (F1 = Scheme 1, F2 = paper Fig. 1 ... F5 = paper Fig. 4). Caption/panel mismatches: F5d caption names MOF and NixPyOz but the panel shows one series family (times to ~730 s, i.e. NixPyOz); F5e caption names only NixPyOz but the panel plots both. Phase identity rests on a poorly crystalline pattern with partial card agreement (audit o5). Cycling retention (~54%) is modest; the electrolyte is not stated in any caption, so the Ni redox assignment (k2) is generic.
